component.name: core.openwop.workflows.campaign-sync
component.description: Campaign Studio metrics-sync chain (RFC 0013; campaign gap plan C2 on ADR 0159). Pulls a rolling 7-day look-back of daily ad metrics, with conversions and revenue, for the dispatched campaigns or the whole configured ad account through the acting user's platform connection (ctx.ads; each day's row is replaced on re-pull, so late conversions settle and nothing double-counts) into the unified performance store, then delivers a short sync summary as a notification. Schedule it daily on the ONE scheduler, or run it ad hoc — the 15-minute cooldown makes overlapping fires harmless. Also carries the daily budget-pacing check (ADR 0220). And the hourly conversions delivery (ADR 0907 D7): queued server-side conversions go to the live conversions APIs, consent re-checked per row at send. And the governed budget reallocation (ADR 0952 D3): one approved plan, decreases first. And the product-feed push (ADR 0952 D6): the commerce catalog to Meta Catalog or Google Merchant Center, changed items only.
